topic: The Central Limit Theorem (CLT): The Magic of Averages

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Distributions
lecture_lines: A distribution shows how data spreads.
animations: Fade in a Normal distribution curve: #3498DB.
Label the mean (mu) and standard deviation (sigma): #E74C3C.
Show data points [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/data.svg] falling beneath the curve: #F1C40F.
Highlight the area representing the probability density: #2ECC71.

sections.title: The Problem: Chaos in Small Samples
animations: Show a small histogram with high variance: #E67E22. Incorporate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dice.svg] to represent randomized outcomes.
Transition to a chaotic, shifting distribution shape: #C0392B. Incorporate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/marbles.svg] to visualize the scattering effect.

sections.title: The Mechanism: The Power of Aggregation
lecture_lines: Many averages form a Bell Curve.
animations: Combine three small samples into a larger sum: #1ABC9C. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/beaker.svg]
Show the mean of sums becoming more stable: #2980B9. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scale.svg]
Demonstrate the emerging Bell curve shape: #F39C12. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg]

sections.title: Visualization: The Morphing Animation
lecture_lines: Watch the histogram morph over time.
animations: Start with flat, uniform, or skewed distributions using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dice.svg]: #D35400.
Gradually add more samples to the aggregation: #7F8C8D.
Transform the final aggregate into a Bell curve: #27AE60.
Highlight the narrowing variance as N increases: #9B59B6.
Final overlay comparing normal distribution to sum using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sand.svg]: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Application: Why Does This Matter?
lecture_lines: The CLT bridges samples and populations.
It powers inferential statistics and quality.
animations: Display real-world data like coin flips using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg]: #F1C40F.
Show how CLT predicts outcomes for large groups: #3498DB.
Contrast unpredictable individual coin flips [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg] with predictable aggregate: #E74C3C.
